title: Naito’s Double Gold Dash
summary: Naito seeks the Tokyo Dome triumph that has repeatedly escaped him. A two-night championship race gives him the chance to hold the Intercontinental and heavyweight belts together.

chapters.title: Naito wins the first half of the double
chapters.result: Naito defeats Jay White for the Intercontinental title.
chapters.context: The win earns him the next night’s match against heavyweight champion Okada, putting the Dome dream within reach.

chapters.title: Double champion, interrupted celebration
chapters.result: Naito defeats Okada, then KENTA attacks him afterward.
chapters.context: Naito finally wins the Dome main event and both titles, but KENTA prevents the full celebration and supplies the next antagonist.
